title: Daily Gates & Item Sets
notes: Daily Gates (in the Gate Map): Gold Vault, Training Grounds and Crystal Mine. 3 tries each per day, reset at midnight. Defeats do not cost a try.
Crystal Mine gives Mana Stones, Soul Shards and a guaranteed Epic or better item.
Item sets: Tidecaller (Gate E), Railbreaker (Gate D) and Frostbound (Gate C). Wear 2 or 4 pieces for strong bonuses.
Epic items can belong to a set, Legendary and Mythic items always do. Set items show a small diamond in your bag, and the Champion screen lists your active set bonuses.
